description: This video will show you how to get the most from your membership with Mirror Trading International Sign up today: ...

asr.full_text: Leverage your Mirror Trading International membership to the maximum For purposes of this video we are using dollars, however please be aware that all currency on the Mirror Trading International platform is stated in Bitcoin or BITS The reason why the currency of Mirror Trading International is Bitcoin is because it is important that you grow your Bitcoin so that you can have the added advantage when the value of Bitcoin rises You're a member of Mirror Trading International, and you are wondering if you should tell your friends about this opportunity. But forget your friends for a moment, let's look at what you can do to maximise your membership to your full benefit and take advantage of the system without recruiting a single person. If you are new to the network marketing type of business, you need to find out which side of your business is the team leg Leg and which is the Power Leg. If you see people under you in the 2-legged binary structure, are they going to the left or to the right? People under you to the left indicates that the Power Leg is on the left and your Team Leg is to the right, and vice versa. Start with $200 in your own position, then a position in the PowerLeg for a family member perhaps your mother who will not be interested in going online every day and fund this account with $100. Then open a position for your partner in your TeamLeg. This is the account you are going to put your extra funds into. Let's assume you had a $1000 to start with. You have put $200 in your own accounts and $100 in the position in the power Lake so you'll put the balance of $700 into your partner's position in the team leg let's look at your business so far you have a $200 position and two people that you have introduced one in each leg so you are binary qualified. Let's now look at earnings in an average week where you earn 7%. Your $200 position earned $14. The $100 position to your left, earned $7. And the $700 position to your right, earned $49. You are probably wondering what all the effort is about. Because you would have earned $49. You are probably wondering what all the effort is about because you would have earned $70 if you had $1,000 in your own position. Let's assume that there are already members in your power leg, and the total investment on your left equals $1,500, your right leg is the smaller leg and the binary is calculated on that leg. The actual value of that leg is $749 and the estimated binder will be $740 which is received by your main position at the end of week 2. Please note that this is a simple estimate for illustration purposes only. Let's now assume that the weekly earning is 6%. Here you will see that you are already getting the compound effect as the earnings are on the total balance and not just your original membership figure. The trading bonuses for your 3 positions is thus $64.20 and the value of your membership across the three positions is $1134.20 The value of the smaller leg for the binary calculation is $793.94. An estimated binary will be $8 which is received by your main position at the end of week 3. Again please note this is a simple estimate for illustration purposes only. Let's have a look at your 3 positions and the bonuses earned so far. You'll be receiving $ dollars and seventy dollars in referral bonuses for the two positions you have introduced. In addition, you receive a binary bonus from week one of seven dollars forty bringing your main account total to three hundred fourteen dollars twenty four. You could draw the extra one hundred and fourteen dollars twenty four and go shopping or you could simply withdraw that and add it to your partner's position in your team leg so that you receive the full benefit from the binary in your smaller leg. Looking at Week 3, let's assume the earnings are 8%. The trading bonuses now bring the value of your membership to 1011 dollars and 32 cents. You can also see how the binary bonus is increasing as the value of your small leg increases. The binary sharing bonus is calculated weekly, and is increasing as the value of your smaller leg increases! The binary sharing bonus is calculated weekly and is based on the value of your smaller leg. Please note that binary bonuses and referral bonuses are paid into your activation wallet a week in arrears. From here these amounts can be moved into your trading pool account or withdrawn depending on what you would like to do. The reality is that within a year you have earned approximately 50% of the value of your smallest leg based on the success of the trading. In 2 years you have received bonuses equivalent to or more than the value of the smaller leg of your business, and it will simply continue. Now imagine what could happen if you show this to your friends and they started joining your team leg. If you have questions, or for more information, please contact Clint.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes funding multiple positions in a two-legged binary structure, including positions for family members and a partner, to generate referral and binary bonuses. It presents illustrative weekly returns of 6% to 8% and claims approximately 50% in one year, at least 100% in two years, and that the income will continue for life, then encourages viewers to show the opportunity to friends. These claims and the recruitment-dependent earning structure actively solicit participation rather than merely explaining or criticizing it.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video explicitly teaches a two-legged Power Leg/Team Leg structure, requires multiple funded positions, describes referral and binary bonuses, and connects earnings to people joining the team. S03 is secondary because the presentation also links participation to recurring and compounding trading-pool returns.
